2609.11180.title: SemVerBench: Benchmarking LLM Comprehension of Version-Constraint Resolution Semantics
2609.11180.paper_summary: Large language model (LLM) coding agents constantly decide whether a version satisfies a constraint such as ^1.2.3 or >=2.0,<3, yet their grasp of version-constraint semantics has never been measured directly. We introduce SemVerBench, the first benchmark of LLM version-constraint resolution semantics across three ecosystems (npm, PEP 440, Cargo): 240 machine-checkable items with unique answers, built author-neutrally from four balanced sources (each ecosystem's official test suite plus three frontier LLM proposers) and labeled by a non-circular two-implementation oracle. Evaluating six frontier models, we find systematic, predictable per-mechanism blind spots: a partial-comparator carry rule (>1.2 means >=1.3.0) traps every model on Cargo (near 60%), and although standard PEP 440 prefix matching is universal, on zero-pad/post-release corner cases GPT-5.1 collapses (0/26) while Claude stays at 97-100% (verified on a 67-item oracle-validated set). Opus significantly outperforms all other models, and Sonnet outperforms the OpenAI models (McNemar). The failures look more like an activation/application gap than a knowledge gap: injecting the rule or a light correct hint recovers most errors, whereas interval decomposition does not, and models are at ceiling on the basic forms of the same rules. An author-stratified analysis finds no statistically significant self-favoritism. Because the task is verifiable and a free, 100%-correct resolver exists, tool delegation reaches ~100%: coding agents should delegate version resolution to a resolver rather than reason about versions in-head.
2609.11180.paper_summary_zh: 大型語言模型（LLM）編碼代理不斷決定某個版本是否滿足約束條件，例如 ^1.2.3 或 >=2.0,<3，但它們對版本約束語義的掌握從未被直接測量過。<lb/>我們推出了 SemVerBench，這是第一個針對三個生態系統（npm、PEP 440、Cargo）的 LLM 版本約束解析語義的基準：240 個具有唯一答案的機器可檢查項目，這些項目是從四個平衡來源中中立構建的（每個生態系統的官方測試套件加上三個前沿 LLM 提議者），並由一個非循環的雙實現預言機標記。<lb/>在評估六個前沿模型時，我們發現系統性、可預測的每個機制盲點：一個部分比較器攜帶規則（>1.2 意味著 >=1.3.0）使每個模型在 Cargo 上陷入困境（接近 60%），儘管標準 PEP 440 前綴匹配是普遍的，但在零填充/發佈後邊緣案例中，GPT-5.1 崩潰（0/26），而 Claude 則保持在 97-100%（在 67 項目預言機驗證集上驗證）。<lb/>Opus 顯著超越所有其他模型，而 Sonnet 超越 OpenAI 模型（McNemar）。<lb/>這些失敗看起來更像是激活/應用差距而不是知識差距：注入規則或輕微的正確提示可以恢復大多數錯誤，而區間分解則無法，模型在相同規則的基本形式上達到上限。<lb/>一項作者分層分析未發現統計上顯著的自我偏愛。<lb/>由於該任務是可驗證的，並且存在一個免費的、100%正確的解析器，因此工具委派達到約 100%：編碼代理應該將版本解析委派給解析器，而不是在腦中推理版本。
2609.11180.author: Qibai Chen et.al.
